once -- which is why they live here instead of being copy-pasted into each
Only add a prompt here when nothing in the catalog is close to it. A prompt
that sits near one skill in particular belongs in THAT skill's dataset,
where it is reported as that skill's near-miss and its owner is the one who
Every evaluation here is `skill_should_trigger: false`, and true is an
error: this file belongs to no skill, so there is nothing for it to name.
A false trigger here is much more serious than a near-miss failure. It means
a description is broad enough to capture ordinary programming work.
